newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's CPC buys Nov/Dec fuel oil at $141-$142/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC buys Nov/Dec fuel oil at $141-$142/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has purchased by tender 38,000 tonnes of low sulphur fuel oil between $141 and $142 a tonne for delivery between November and December, a CPC source said on Tuesday.
The cargo of 0.5-percent sulphur fuel oil is for November 16-December 10 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung or Shen Ao.
The tender closed October 7 and was valid until October 9.
In its last tender, CPC bought 38,000 tonnes of 0.5-percent sulphur fuel oil at $138 per tonne for November 1-10 delivery, c-and-f Keelung or Shen Ao.
